vibe_rationale: One-day LGBTIQ+ street party with a real community core in Melbourne's creative precinct, but large, civic and formal in format.
fit_notes: Free, all-ages LGBTIQ+ street party where the community has specific health needs, so the link is real, but the crowd is not adult-only. A partner route exists through Midsumma's partnership page, and NAB is the major partner. The 84,789 figure covers the full 2025 program, not the street party alone, and no health partner is evident.
